name: Rajorshi Patranabis

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Rajorshi Patranabis is a multilingual poet, translator and editor whose writing moves between English and Bengali and between several poetic forms. His collections include The Last Drop of Your Tears and Checklist Anomaly, both exploring five-line poetry. He has also translated Sutapa Chakraborty’s The Hornet’s Trail into English. In an interview with Borderless, he describes his interest in haiku and haibun as part of the path towards these shorter forms.

“Crippling assortment” compresses the struggle to write and believe into a sequence of unsettled images. Words become clouded prisms; intuition and contradiction pull against one another. Its brief final stanza leaves faith still labouring towards belief, giving the poem an unresolved, questioning close.
